name: lighthouse-obsidian-plugin
description: Lighthouse is a focus-aware workspace for Obsidian.

scripts.dev: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && LIGHTHOUSE_BUILD_INFO=1 node scripts/copy-release-assets.mjs && node esbuild.config.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/copy-release-assets.mjs && node scripts/verify-release.mjs
scripts.build:dev: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && LIGHTHOUSE_BUILD_INFO=1 node scripts/copy-release-assets.mjs
scripts.test:deploy: pnpm run build:dev && pnpm run test:update
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
